slides.title: Before you put up one holiday decoration, take this down first
Clear the surface you'll decorate
slides.body: Mantel, shelf, table. Everyday stuff goes into the empty decor bin for now.

slides.title: The bin holds the swap
slides.body: When decor comes out, daily stuff goes in. When decor goes back, they trade again.

slides.title: Decorate 3 spots, not every room
slides.body: Front door, one table, one window. Enough to feel festive, small enough to take down.

slides.title: Snap a photo of each spot
slides.body: Next year you copy the photo. No re-deciding where everything goes.

slides.title: Decor added on top of clutter becomes more clutter.
Grab the declutter tracker
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a declutter tracker and a 30-day declutter challenge. Link in bio.
